# Road to Goals

> A study planner. Plans are resources in study order, with time estimates, optionally grouped into phases. Users can have their own AI write a plan and paste it into the app.

## Writing a plan

- [Plan skill, version 1](https://roadtogoals.com/ai/skill-v1.md): how to write a plan, with output rules and an example
- [Latest plan skill](https://roadtogoals.com/ai/skill.md): always a copy of the newest version
- [Plan JSON Schema, version 1](https://roadtogoals.com/ai/plan-schema-v1.json)
- [Example plan, version 1](https://roadtogoals.com/ai/example-plan-v1.json)
